criteria.answer:
Every cleaned chunk file is saved to `data-format-v2/question-intake/year-2/semester-2/MCNS-2 [Central Nervous System]/_cleaned/` with a numbered filename (e.g. `chunk_001.txt`, `chunk_002.txt`, ...).
No question is silently dropped: the total number of detected question boundaries in the raw file equals the total number of `QUESTION_TYPE:` blocks across all cleaned chunk files plus the total number of entries in the FLAGGED, SATA, and REMOVED sections.
The cleaned output follows the EXACT OCR cleaner prompt template (Section 3): every block has `QUESTION_TYPE`, `SUBJECT`, `CHAPTER`, `LECTURE`, `TEXT`, `ANSWER`, `EXPLANATION: N/A`, and `KEY_CONCEPT: N/A`.
Flagged, SATA, and REMOVed questions are collected in a separate `flagged_review.txt` file with raw text preserved and clear reasons stated.
A final verification command (`npx tsx data-format-v2/scripts/validate-cleaner-output.ts` run on all chunks) confirms structural soundness with 0 errors.
The original raw file is never modified — read-only access only.

phases.answer: Build Pipeline & Pilot, Bulk Processing, Verification & Assembly

phaseSnapshots.name: Build Pipeline & Pilot
phaseSnapshots.goal: Write a TypeScript batch-cleaning script, validate the approach on 3 pilot chunks, and confirm output quality.
phaseSnapshots.description: Create `data-format-v2/scripts/cleaner-batch.ts` that reads the raw file, detects major section boundaries (Part 1-13 + Head & Neck), splits each section into ~80-question chunks, prepends the full OCR cleaner prompt, calls OpenRouter GPT-4o, and saves cleaned output to `_cleaned/chunk_XXX.txt`. Includes retry logic, progress tracking, and resume capability. Run on the first 3 chunks, validate outputs with `validate-cleaner-output.ts`, and adjust the prompt/script if needed.

steps.description: Write the cleaner-batch.ts script with chunking, LLM calling, retry logic, and resume support.
Run the script in pilot mode on the first 3 chunks and inspect raw outputs.
Validate pilot outputs using the existing validator script.

phaseSnapshots.name: Bulk Processing
phaseSnapshots.goal: Process all remaining chunks through the validated pipeline.
phaseSnapshots.description: Run `cleaner-batch.ts` across the entire file. The script automatically skips already-processed chunks (resume capability), processes ~70 chunks in total, respects rate limits (~5 concurrent calls), and logs progress. Each chunk receives the full OCR cleaner prompt plus its raw text segment. Outputs are saved as individual `_cleaned/chunk_XXX.txt` files.

steps.description: Execute the bulk cleaning run for all chunks in the raw file.

phaseSnapshots.name: Verification & Assembly
phaseSnapshots.goal: Validate every chunk, reconcile question counts, and assemble final deliverables.
phaseSnapshots.description: Run `validate-cleaner-output.ts` on every chunk. Count total QUESTION_TYPE blocks and compare against detected raw-question boundaries via a reconciliation script. Assemble all FLAGGED, SATA, and REMOVED sections from every chunk into a single `flagged_review.txt`. Produce a summary report. Optionally concatenate all clean chunks into one master file.

steps.description: Validate all chunk files with the existing validator.

verification.command: for f in 'data-format-v2/question-intake/year-2/semester-2/MCNS-2 [Central Nervous System]/_cleaned/chunk_'*'.txt'; do npx tsx data-format-v2/scripts/validate-cleaner-output.ts "$f" || exit 1; done

steps.description: Run a reconciliation script that counts raw questions vs clean + flagged + SATA + removed.

verification.command: npx tsx data-format-v2/scripts/reconcile-counts.ts 'data-format-v2/question-intake/year-2/semester-2/MCNS-2 [Central Nervous System]/_raw/main CNS questions.txt' 'data-format-v2/question-intake/year-2/semester-2/MCNS-2 [Central Nervous System]/_cleaned/'

assumptions.answer: The OpenRouter API key in `.env.local` remains valid with sufficient quota for ~70 LLM calls.; ~80-100 questions per chunk (~15-30 KB of raw text) fits comfortably within GPT-4o's context window alongside the full OCR cleaner prompt.; The OCR cleaner prompt works effectively on the actual file content; the pilot phase may reveal minor prompt tweaks needed.; Processing ~70 chunks will complete within a reasonable wall-clock time (API-latency dependent, likely 30-90 minutes).; Some garbled text at the very beginning (Arabic dedication, table of contents) may be unrecoverable and will be properly flagged by the LLM rather than silently dropped.

payload.summary: Phase 1 complete. Built cleaner-batch.ts script with chunking, retry logic, resume support. Ran pilot on 3 chunks using Gemini API (after OpenRouter free-tier failure). Validated all outputs with 0 errors after fixing validator edge cases: SATA regex, matching/case/essay ANSWER handling, case TEXT via CASE_TEXT, empty block cleanup. Ready for Phase 2 bulk processing.
